description: The third recognized contextualization branch. A generated placeholder declared with template members (translation plus fragment alternatives) is an ExpressionTranslation rather than a LanguageFormTranslation, and an expression evaluated over a non-numeric operand raises the library's own ExpressionEvaluationException -- the one recognized type at DefaultStrings.java:1270-1271 that no other fixture in this family can reach. Fragment.ViaPhonetic puts that fragment behind a phonetic placeholder, so a SUCCESSFUL resolver answer decides whether the fragment is reached at all. One locale, so the policy is never consulted and the contextualization is isolated.

Fragment.ViaPhonetic.commentary: The resolver's answer selects either a template that names the expression fragment or one that does not, so the callback's return value decides whether a later failure happens at all.
